title: Akiyama Mizuki — Cascading Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He should be here soon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Mizuki. Apologies for the wait.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I was surprised you asked to meet with me like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, since the teachers are the ones who are usually on your case!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? Doesn't that also apply to you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! True...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Regardless, what's gotten into you all of a sudden? You wished to talk about something...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I heard from Ena that you were pretty worried about me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am also your friend, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I actually had a chance to speak with her again yesterday after running into her on my way home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you for telling me all about Mizuki and yourself the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I had a much clearer idea of what I needed to say and do after hearing that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, thank you very much. I really appreciate what you did...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I didn't mean to put you in such a tough spot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't mind me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I just did what I could to help.
It was sort of my personal hope.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your hope...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can hope.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That you'll get to be yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can hope that you're going to experience true happiness.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's my sincere wish as your friend.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, we both seem to falter in the face of powerful feelings...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
That also happened to you, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I found myself completely overwhelmed by these strong and straightforward emotions.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I basically was too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I want us to stay friends!
Which means it's natural that I'd want to make the right choice!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care what other people say or how hard it's going to be to deal with all this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because never seeing you again would hurt more!!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're the one who's changed, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've been trying to talk to you, but you haven't been listening...! You've just been running away...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you're seriously wondering if it's okay for us to keep being friends?! To me, that sounds really stupid because...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You have been and always will be my dear friend!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that at least getting through to you?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All of my excuses stopped working and she left me no room to escape.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, she had a response for everything...!
I honestly thought for a second that she was gonna grab my collar and slap me silly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. She really gave you no room to run.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's no way for me to best her when she gets like that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Sounds like we've both made quite formidable friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This isn't a dream, right? It's all happening for real?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this is the real world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The world where you'll be tackling a mountain of supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oof...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because this is all happening for real, I think you can feel at ease and dream big.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alongside your dear friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Welcome to this side, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, don't start acting like a senior on me now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But I am your senior.
Imagine me watching you while standing at the back with my arms crossed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Eww! Just the thought of that irritates me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Rui
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehehe.
